name: Chinmai Kyuuketsuki no Ojou-sama ni Torawareta Ore wa, Nyotaika Saserarete Juujun na Imouto Maid ni Choukyou Sareteshimau Sou Desu
original_name: ちんまい吸血姫のお嬢様に囚われた俺は、女体化させられて従順な妹メイドに調教されてしまうそうです。
source:
Yokomizo Mitsuru becomes stranded on a snow-covered mountain during a blizzard. While searching for help, he collapses, only to awaken in a mysterious forest. At its center stands a solitary mansion, where he encounters two vampires: Chris and Kanon.

Just when he thinks he’s been rescued, Chris drinks his blood, and his body transforms into that of a girl. Now renamed Maron, she is made to work as a maid in Chris’s mansion. As she grows accustomed to her new body and surroundings, her sense of identity gradually begins to change.

[From [url=https://www.nookgaming.com/kagami-games-to-release-7-visual-novels-including-sakura-moyu/]NookGaming.com[/url]]
translation:
横沟满在暴风雪中被困在一座白雪覆盖的山上。在寻求帮助时，他倒下了，并在一片神秘的森林中醒来。在它的中心矗立着一座孤独的宅邸，他在那里遇到了两个吸血鬼：克里斯和卡农。

就在克里斯以为自己被救了的时候，克里斯喝了他的血，他的身体变成了一个女孩。现在改名为马龙，她被要求在克里斯的豪宅里当女仆。随着她逐渐习惯新的身体和环境，她的认同感逐渐开始改变。

[来自[url=https://www.nookgaming.com/kagami-games-to-release-7-visual-novels-including-sakura-moyu/]NookGaming.com[/url]]
